Histeon rimesso da una copia di sicurezz: Histeon put back from a safety copy
Prima che WordPress installi una nuova v: Before WordPress installs a new version of Histeon (from the plugins screen, with automatic updates, with its updater or by uploading a ZIP that replaces the installed one), Histeon copies its folder and its tables (versions, releases, log, deployments). The last two copies are kept, in an uploads folder closed to the web.
Non sono nella copia: i contenuti del si: Not in the copy: the site's content (pages, posts, media, menus), Histeon's settings, the data of the modules (Lingua Bridge, Static Bridge: their code is, in the folder), other plugins and the theme. For those you need a backup of the site.
Su un multisito Histeon non fa copie di: On a multisite network Histeon makes no safety copies: the plugin folder belongs to every site, the tables to each one.
La copia automatica prima degli aggiorna: The automatic copy before updates is turned off in wp-config.php (XB_UPDATE_BACKUP).
Nessuna copia ancora: la prima nasce al: No copies yet: the first one is made at the next update, or now.
%1$d file della cartella, %2$d righe nel: %1$d files of the folder, %2$d rows in the tables, %3$s
Rimetti Histeon %s: la cartella del plug: Put back Histeon %s: the plugin folder and the tables go back to the copy; versions saved after the copy disappear from the history (pages stay as they are).
Torna alla versione di prima: Go back to the previous version
La copia più vecchia lascia il posto all: The oldest copy makes room for the new one.
Non hai i permessi per le copie di sicur: You do not have permission to manage Histeon's safety copies.
Conferma il ritorno alla copia con la ca: Confirm going back to the copy with the box next to the button.
Histeon %s è tornato com’era nella copia: Histeon %s is back as it was in the copy, with its tables.
